info.description: Metadata ingestion and detection API for unstructured data sources. Supports WordPress, Slack, S3-Compatible Storage, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, Hive, Databricks, Snowflake, MongoDB, PowerBI, Tableau, Confluence, Jira, Service Desk, Notion, Email, and YouTube sources. Built-in detectors for secrets, PII, toxic content, image classification, broken links, and security threats.

detectorRunsSkipped.description: Individual detector runs the scan cache avoided across all assets, including partial skips where only some detectors had to re-run.

scopeFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the scope-determining config this run covered. Runs sharing a fingerprint are directly comparable.

totalFindings.description: Findings currently associated with this run — created, re-detected, or resolved by it. NOT a count of new discoveries: after reconciliation it is closer to the source's open set as of this run. Use findingsCreated for what this run actually found that was new.

findingsCreated.description: Findings first seen by this run.

findingsResolved.description: Previously open findings resolved by this run.

findingsRetained.description: Previously known findings re-detected and retained as current by this run.

assetsWithoutText.description: Assets that should have carried text but yielded none — typically OCR or transcription returning empty. These are not errors: the asset ingested fine, but its content was never read, so any detector result for it covers nothing. Read alongside assetsUnchanged before trusting a run: a high value means the corpus is largely unscanned.

assetHashes.description: Asset hashes to register as PENDING

includeScanCache.description: Return each asset's persisted scan-cache state alongside the registration. The CLI uses it to skip assets whose content and detector configuration are unchanged. It must be read here, before the discovery ingest overwrites the stored checksum with the incoming one.

includePayloadCursor.description: Return each asset's stored payload cursor — how far a sampling strategy has read into that asset's tabular payload. The CLI resumes an AUTOMATIC sweep from it instead of restarting at row 0. Requested independently of includeScanCache: a position is not proof that a scan completed, and sources that never opted into the scan cache still page their payloads.

detectors.description: Configuration fingerprint each detector last succeeded with, keyed by detector type or CUSTOM::<key>

hash.description: Asset hash the cursor belongs to

cursor.description: Opaque, CLI-defined cursor: `{ v, kind, offset, rows_seen, passes, exhausted, checksum, strategy }`. The API stores and returns it without interpreting it; the CLI discards one whose checksum or strategy no longer matches.

cache.description: Present only when includeScanCache was requested. An asset appears here only if its last scan completed cleanly enough to persist scan-cache state, so an absent hash always means "process this in full".

payloadCursors.description: Present only when includePayloadCursor was requested. An asset appears here if it has a stored payload position, whatever its scan-cache state; an absent hash means the sweep of that payload starts at row 0.

findingsByDetector.description: Finding counts per detector: { [detectorType]: { total, critical?, high?, … } }

cacheHit.description: The run skipped this asset on scan-cache evidence instead of scanning it. Its finding counts are carried forward from the previous scan.

internalPairs.description: Pairs whose two assets are both inside this source.

topShare.description: Share of pairs on the single heaviest source pairing. High means the duplicates have one findable cause; even spread points at the matcher instead.

decidedByAgent.description: Of the decided pairs, how many an agent decided. Kept apart so the headline stays a count of human work — an agent clearing the safe band must not make the queue look worked through.

assetsAffected.description: Distinct assets appearing in at least one scored pair. The duplicate rate is this over totalAssets — a cluster count says nothing without a denominator.

relatedMin.description: Current relatedMin from the tuning config

duplicateMin.description: Current duplicateMin from the tuning config

lineageHairball.description: True when a dominant lineage component made the derivation test unusable, so lineage states read UNKNOWN rather than claiming a path.

hairballDemoted.description: True when a dominant lineage component made the derivation test unusable, so lineage reads UNKNOWN rather than claiming a path.

labels.description: Full label set, not the truncated pattern key

sharedValues.description: The values the two assets actually share, capped. Lets a reviewer tell a distinctive match from shared boilerplate without opening the pair.

undecidedTotal.description: Undecided pairs matching the same filters

lineageDegree.description: Count of derivation edges touching this asset. Zero means we have no lineage here — which is not the same as knowing there is no path.

valueHash.description: Reverse-index key, so the token disclosure can ask where else this value appears without re-deriving the hash in the browser.

potential.description: Weight this label could have contributed if it matched perfectly. Positive bar.

actual.description: Weight it actually contributed, from the scorer. potential + penalty.

penalty.description: actual - potential. Never positive: this is the evidence against, and it is inside the sum rather than hidden in a blend.

weight.description: Raw label weight, for the tooltip

total.description: Sum of the bars — equals the displayed score

perfect.description: Sum of every potential bar. Always 1 for an exact-pass pair: the score is the fraction of available weight that matched.

storedScore.description: The score as stored. Should equal total; a mismatch means the scorer and this decomposition disagree.

phonetic.description: True when the pair came from the phonetic pass, whose contributions are fuzzy match sums rather than whole-value counts.

isWeakest.description: The weakest edge whose removal disconnects the cluster — the one worth cutting.

truncated.description: Members omitted to keep the picture readable

escalate.description: Whether this pair should be escalated: similar, both sides have lineage, and no path between them — convergent duplication rather than a derived copy.

verdict.description: Existing verdict, if this pair was already decided

verdictStale.description: True when the pair has been re-scored materially since it was decided, so the standing judgement was made about a different number.

scoreAtVerdict.description: Score the reviewer saw when they decided

currentScore.description: Score now. Null when the pair is no longer in the index at all.

stale.description: The pair has been re-scored materially since the decision was taken.

decidedByKind.description: 'ai' when an agent decided it, else 'operator'

unactioned.description: Decided but not yet taken anywhere

byVerdict.description: Counts by verdict across the whole namespace

byAgent.description: Decisions an agent took, not a person

share.description: Share of the score this label contributed

dominantLabel.description: The single label responsible for most of the score, when there is one — the thing to lower or exclude.

similarPairs.description: How many other pairs in the corpus this same label combination produced. A big number means fixing it clears a lot at once.

skipped.description: Pairs skipped because they are not in the index

undoable.description: False when the index was rebuilt after this batch, so replaying it may not restore what the reviewer saw. Undo is not unbounded time travel and the UI must say so rather than failing quietly.

excludeLabel.description: For EXCLUSION patterns: also write a correlation exclusion rule for this label, so the boilerplate stops driving matches at all.

workRemainingBefore.description: Undecided pairs before this action, across the whole corpus

exclusionRuleId.description: Exclusion rule created, when the pattern warranted one
